# uzc_monitoring_charts (Data Source)

Lists the monitoring chart definitions UzCloud exposes (GET /monitoring/charts). This is the catalog of available charts, not chart data points; see the per-VM endpoints under /monitoring for actual time series (not modeled by this provider).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_monitoring_charts" "all" {
  os_family = "linux"
}

output "monitoring_chart_slugs" {
  value = [for c in data.uzc_monitoring_charts.all.charts : c.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `os_family` (String) Filter by OS family, e.g. "linux".
- `virtual_machine` (String) Filter by virtual machine slug.

### Read-Only

- `charts` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--charts))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
